newsitem.title: USA: Helisys aims to save $600,000 annually.
newsitem.headline: Helisys aims to save $600,000 annually.

text.p: Helisys Inc said it adopted a series of actions to cut costs, streamline operations, reduce overhead, and return the company to profitability.
The company said the changes are designed to save $600,000 annually.
The changes include new cost control systems, revised budgeting procedures and restructuring some personnel assignments.
It said it did not anticipate any interruption in the quality of service or new product development as a result of the changes.
